rows.grounds: particle introducing the specification of regions
fused form indicating regions above and below the navel; internal members nābheḥ, ūrdhvam, adhas, tathā

items.question: What alternative forms of bodily purification are prescribed for regions above and below the navel?
premises: Bathing is prescribed as one option.
Washing is prescribed as an alternative option.
The prescription applies to regions above and below the navel.
items.inference: One should either bathe or wash, applying the purification likewise above and below the navel.
uncertainties: The exact ritual distinction between snāyāt and prakṣālayet in this context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: One should either bathe or wash, doing so above and below the navel as well.
